headline: Semantica Brings Governance and Causal Reasoning to AI Agents
lede: This infrastructure layer moves beyond standard vector RAG by constructing a structured knowledge graph for LLM-driven decision-making. It provides the deterministic reasoning and audit trails necessary for high-stakes environments like finance and healthcare.

headline: Curated Expert Personalities for Your Development Workflow
lede: Forget generic prompts and build a dream team of specialized AI agents tailored to specific technical roles. This project offers a modular way to inject expert-level behavior directly into your favorite coding environments.

headline: Streamline Multi-Platform Content Crawling with Browser Automation
lede: MediaCrawler leverages Playwright to bypass complex reverse engineering, making it simple to pull public data from major platforms into structured formats. It serves as a reliable ingestion layer for researchers and automation specialists.

headline: Standardized Workflows Enforce Quality Gates for AI Coding Agents
lede: This framework moves agents past ad-hoc prompting by implementing twenty-four vetted engineering skills and lifecycle stages. It ensures that autonomous systems adhere to strict production-grade standards during code generation.

headline: Orchestrating Autonomous Workforce Teams at Scale
lede: Paperclip treats AI models like employees by providing a centralized control plane for task management, budgeting, and performance tracking. It fills the gap for organizations transitioning from experimental scripts to governed autonomous operations.

headline: Self-Improving Agents Gain Durable Memory and Long-Running Execution
lede: Prime Agent breaks the limitations of ephemeral chat by maintaining state through a persistent IPython REPL and background daemon processes. It enables complex, long-running coding tasks that evolve alongside the codebase.

headline: Building an Independent Web Browser from the Ground Up
lede: Ladybird rejects established engine dependencies in favor of a custom, multi-process architecture derived from SerenityOS. This project serves as a critical testbed for modern web standard implementation and rendering stability.

headline: Monitoring Home Activity Through WiFi Signals Without Cameras
lede: RuView utilizes Channel State Information from affordable hardware to detect physical movement and health metrics locally. By avoiding cloud reliance and optical imaging, it provides a high-fidelity, privacy-preserving sensing solution.

headline: A Unified Infrastructure Layer for Agentic Productivity
lede: LifeOS acts as a persistent bridge for your AI agents, handling long-term context and personal preference storage. It creates a cohesive, self-improving workspace that adapts to complex, multi-stage projects.

headline: Convert Complex Websites into Clean Data for AI Models
lede: Firecrawl automates the difficult parts of web scraping, such as dynamic rendering and schema enforcement, to feed LLMs high-quality context. It allows developers to integrate live web data into agent workflows with minimal configuration.
